portName: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

portInfo.description: RAK Ports operates several harbours; cruise is hosted at Ras Al Khaimah Port, described as a city-centre port with a modern passenger/cruise terminal beside Old Town. The cruise services page states the dedicated terminal accepts boutique cruise vessels up to 214 metres LOA, with e-gate immigration/customs, concierge, café, wifi and wheelchair accessibility. The May 2024 Ruling Depth & UKC manual (RP MD 005 V7.0) separately states maximum turning size guidance and that cruise vessels up to 210 m and 6.9 m draft (others case-by-case) use the harbour, listing Jetty 4–6 and 8 as cruise berths with lengths 125 / 125 / 130 / 180 m and ruling depths around 7.5 m on those jetties. Saqr Port / Free Zone is the emirate’s industrial bulk hub and is not treated here as the cruise pier. Door GPS remains null.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Manar or Naeem Mall — ~10 min drive claimed.
Jebel Jais — long road; only on long calls.
Ras Al Khaimah Old Town / Museum / Corniche
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not confuse Saqr industrial port with the city-centre cruise terminal.
